ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Defender Context Menu Removed
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of reg.exe or PowerShell to delete the Windows Defender context menu handler registry keys.
This action removes the "Scan with Microsoft Defender" option from the right-click menu for files, directories, and drives.
Attackers may use this technique to hinder manual, on-demand scans and reduce the visibility of the security product.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "powershell\_ise\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*del.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Remove\\-Item.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ri\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\shellex\\\\ContextMenuHandlers\\\\EPP.*"))
